Welcome to the Renown Realm!

NEW: WoW Forever Warrior talents!
- All three trees rebuilt: Spearing Strike, Weaponmaster, Bloodthrill, Raging Blows, Gore Drinker, Vanguard, Master of Defense and more
- Warrior talents have been reset for free - open your talent pane and respec

Barrens Front (1-19) and Plaguelands Front (55-60): warbands, field orders, caravans, heroes and Renown gear.

Click the banner button in game for the PvP panel.
